title: Emergency Water Bottle
description: This mod adds a single use, throwable water source!
body:
### **Description**

This mod adds a single use, throwable bottle of water that, wherever it lands, will place a single water source block! Perfect for clutching up or throwing water to higher places to make climbing easier. I'm sure there's more uses than that, but you'll have to discover them yourself!

 

### **Recipe**

[Recipe for 3 Emergency Water Bottles](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1a8f1c1714c82ed2e7ed45e07b9a64a855e3fcd6.png)

As simple as 1 iron nugget, 3 glass, and 1 water bucket. This will result in 3 whole emergency water bottles! And you even get to keep the bucket when you're done! What a steal!

 

### **Feedback**

If you find any bugs, give me a comment or a message right here in Modrinth or CurseForge and I'll see what I can do about it. Thanks for playing!!
